change_log.value: Implement detection of stuck or orphaned locks using TTL expiration and missing execution heartbeat signals. stories.title: Brain Lock Schema and TTL Contract
stories.description: Define the lock structure for Brain execution including fields for lock_id, owner (process/agent), acquired_at, expires_at (TTL), status (active/expired/released), and correlation_id. Establish validation and persistence contract for lock lifecycle management.

stories.title: Lock Acquisition with TTL Enforcement
stories.description: Implement core lock acquisition logic that sets TTL on lock creation, prevents concurrent acquisition when active, and allows takeover when lock is expired. Ensure atomic check-and-set behavior to avoid race conditions.

stories.title: Deadlock Detection and Recovery Mechanism
stories.description: Implement detection of stuck or orphaned locks using TTL expiration and missing execution heartbeat signals. Introduce periodic heartbeat updates from Brain execution and detect stale locks when heartbeat age exceeds threshold. Automatically release or override expired/stale locks and log recovery events.

stories.title: Lock Management Interface (Internal API)
stories.description: Expose internal functions for lock acquire, renew (heartbeat update), release, status check, and forced unlock to support Brain runner and ops tooling. Enforce guardrails: only owner can renew/release, forced unlock requires admin context, and all actions are audit-logged.

stories.title: Lock Lifecycle Testing and Integration
stories.description: Develop unit and integration tests covering lock acquisition, TTL expiration, heartbeat renewal, stale lock detection, deadlock recovery, forced unlock, and concurrent execution race conditions. Validate behavior within Brain loop execution flows.
